author: rememes
body:
I'm late but why was Rendezvous removed? 
it's not a bad map, and I'm not just saying that out of nostalgic feel, it truly brought out the best quality games.
It could at least still be on the map roster for scrim servers or something.

title: Rendezvous

replies.author: Crazy_
replies.body: Rendezvous is no longer in the rotations because it has been replaced with Rendezvous Redux, which is a better version of the map. The original Rendezvous is still in the map repository, therefore it is still available for setting on scrim servers.
